Entries.Original: Izumi, your set of skills makes you effective at breaking Cancers' exoskeletons.
Asakura's talent lies in dealing damage to the Cancers' bodies once their exoskeletons have been broken.
Once you've broken through, utilize Kayamori and Asakura's offensive capabilities to finish the job.
Now, show me... Do you have what it takes to beat your competition?
Each unit in a squad has their own specialized role in combat.
Yuki is a Breaker.\nShe is proficient at dealing DP damage.
Ruka is an Attacker.\nShe is proficient at dealing HP damage.
Karen is a Blaster.\nShe can greatly increase the enemy's Damage Bonus rate after they enter a break state.
This knowledge should help you devise a strategy to quickly and efficiently eliminate the enemy.
